description: The file defines a PHP class EmployeeMembershipAPI that implements a REST API endpoint for managing employee memberships within a Human Resource Management system. It includes CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) and integrates with service and data access layers to handle employee membership data, including validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipAPI
classes.description: A PHP class implementing API endpoints for CRUD operations on employee memberships, with integrated validation, documentation, and interaction with service/data layers.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipService
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of the EmployeeMembershipService instance.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request for retrieving a single employee membership by employee number and membership id.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request for listing all memberships of an employee, with search and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new employee membership.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a membership.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules common to create and update requests.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing employee membership.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a membership.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove one or more employee memberships for a given employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Internal method to create or update EmployeeMembership entities based on request data.
